visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 1 - The Concept and Taxonomy of Sovereignty
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Treating all four thinkers as saying the same thing about "supremacy". The paper asks for exact differences; the taxonomy is how you supply them.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 2 - Bodin: The Absolute and Perpetual Power of the Commonwealth
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Equating Bodin with Austin. Bodin ALLOWS higher-law restraints; Austin's legal sovereign is formally unlimited.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 3 - Austin I: The Command Theory of Legal Sovereignty
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Calling Austin's sovereign "the state in the abstract." It is a DETERMINATE person or body -- a legislature or monarch fits better than diffuse democratic opinion.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 4 - Austin II: Criticisms and Compatibility with Democracy
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: A flat "Austin is/ isn't compatible with democracy." The mark is in the two-level answer -- legally yes, constitutionally-politically no.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 5 - Kelsen and Hart: The Post-Austinian Refinement of Legal Sovereignty
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Dating Kelsen to 1961. 1961 is HART. Kelsen's English edition is 1945. If unsure in the hall, name the works in sequence without years.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 6 - Laski and the Pluralist Critique of Absolute Sovereignty
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Presenting pluralism as decentralisation. Laski denies the monistic claim that one final unlimited will exists at all.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 7 - Kautilya I: Saptanga, the Svami and Dandaniti
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Treating the svami as Austin's illimitable sovereign, or danda as blind terror.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 8 - Kautilya II: Mandala, Sadgunya, Yogakshema and Modern Relevance
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Reading the realism as amoral, or transposing ancient monarchy directly onto modern democracy.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 9 - Inter-Thinker Debates, Criticisms and Replies
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: Two sequential mini-essays, or criticisms without replies. Use criticism -> reply -> residual.

visual_blocks.heading: RAPID REVISION 10 - Globalization, Contemporary Sovereignty and Common Traps
visual_blocks.preview: WRONG: "Sovereignty disappears under globalization." Say reconfigured, constrained, pooled, negotiated.
